name: Beldin Steelgrill
summary: At Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, Beldin Steelgrill keeps dwarven war machines running. He is its master technician, renowned in Khaz Modan for repairing siege engines and armored wagons. His work depends on a steady supply of specialized tools.

sections.title: Master of the Treaded Beast
sections.body: Just down the road from Kharanos, Steelgrill's Depot is where dwarven steam tanks and siege engines are tested and serviced. Beldin Steelgrill runs the work as its chief technician, known across Khaz Modan for repairing and tuning armored war wagons. The work is hard on heavy wrenches, cutters, and precision instruments. Beldin needs them constantly, keeping local ironworkers busy supplying his bench.

faq.answer: Beldin Steelgrill runs Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh as its proprietor and master technician. Across Khaz Modan, he is famed for maintaining dwarven siege engines and war wagons.
Just northeast of Kharanos, Steelgrill's Depot is a maintenance and testing yard for the Alliance's steam tanks and heavy mechanized machines.

faq.q: Why does Beldin go through so many tools?
faq.answer: Beldin's work on heavy armor, complex gears, and steam boilers wears through specialized tools quickly. He places demanding orders with nearby smiths to keep his bench supplied.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can see dwarven vehicle craft at work in Beldin's yard, where the Alliance's formidable war machines are maintained.
As a dwarf, you can see Ironforge's industrial craft at Beldin's yard, where dwarven skill reaches beyond hand tools to siege artillery.
